info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Issued Device Management API
info.description: The Issued Device Management API provides operations to update and manage bank-issued devices effectively. This API enables financial institutions to modify device details, ensuring that device information remains current and secure. Common consumers of this API include backend systems within banks and fintech companies that require real-time updates to device status and attributes. Use cases typically involve altering device permissions or configurations based on operational changes or compliance requirements.

patch.summary: Update an issued device administration record.
patch.description: Allows you to update details related to the issued device administration for a specific record identified by its unique resource ID. This operation can be used to modify attributes, manage state changes, and ensure compliance with administrative updates pertaining to issued devices.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating the issued device administration. This body contains the necessary information to modify existing device settings or attributes and should conform to the specified schema.
